title: Add and list tasks
instruction:
Write two functions that manage an in-memory task list:

- add_task(title): Creates a new task dict with an auto-incrementing id (starting from 1), the provided title, and completed=False by default. Appends it to the global tasks list and returns the new task.
- list_tasks(): Returns the full tasks list.

Then call add_task("Learn Python"), add_task("Build API"), and print list_tasks().

next_id = 1

    # Your code here
    pass

def list_tasks():
    # Your code here
    pass

add_task("Learn Python")
add_task("Build API")
print(list_tasks())
solution_code:
tasks = []
next_id = 1

def add_task(title):
    global next_id
    task = {"id": next_id, "title": title, "completed": False}
    tasks.append(task)
    next_id += 1
    return task

def list_tasks():
    return tasks

add_task("Learn Python")
add_task("Build API")
print(list_tasks())

title: Build the full CRUD API endpoints
instruction:
Create FastAPI endpoints for the task manager:
- GET /tasks - List all tasks
- POST /tasks (status_code=201) - Create a task with a title field
- GET /tasks/{task_id} - Get a single task, 404 if not found
- PUT /tasks/{task_id} - Update a task's title and completed fields
- DELETE /tasks/{task_id} (status_code=204) - Delete a task, 404 if not found
starter_code:
from fastapi import FastAPI, HTTPException
from pydantic import BaseModel

app = FastAPI()
tasks = []
next_id = 1

    title: str
    completed: bool = False
